title: Senior Designer, Brand & Creative
description:
About Pantheon
Pantheon WebOps Platform powers the open web, running more than 300,000 sites in the cloud for customers including Google, Princeton, Salesloft and Doctors Without Borders. Every day, thousands of developers and marketers create, iterate, and scale WordPress and Drupal sites to reach billions of people globally. Pantheon ’s multitenant, container-based platform enables organizations to manage all of their websites from a single dashboard. Organizations including Clorox and the United Nations drive results through accelerated development and real-time publishing using Pantheon ’s collaborative workflows.
The Role
Pantheon is looking for a Senior Designer to help shape how our brand shows up across the world.
As a key member of the Brand and Creative team, you will turn strategy into clear, distinctive, and compelling creative work across campaigns, events, executive communications, product storytelling, digital experiences, sales enablement, and internal communications. You will help make Pantheon recognisable, relevant, and memorable for the developers, marketers, IT leaders, agencies, and organisations we serve.
This is a hands-on role for a designer who can move comfortably between big-picture thinking and precise execution. You will bring strong visual judgement, thoughtful craft, and an understanding of how design supports brand perception, audience engagement, and business goals. You will work closely with Brand, Marketing, Events, Product Marketing, Digital, Sales, and executive stakeholders to create work that is both creatively ambitious and effective.
What You’ll Do

• Translate brand strategy, campaign objectives, and audience insights into clear creative concepts and visual systems.

• Develop high-quality design work across digital, print, social, presentations, events, executive communications, sales enablement, and internal channels.

• Create and evolve campaign identities, art direction, layouts, illustrations, motion concepts, and supporting design assets.

• Partner with copywriters, strategists, marketers, event leads, and subject-matter experts to develop integrated creative work from brief through delivery.

• Help with the visual development of major brand moments, including global campaigns, product launches, customer stories, company events, and executive engagements.

• Design experiences that work across audiences, formats, markets, and channels while maintaining a coherent Pantheon brand.

• Bring fresh ideas, references, and perspectives to the team, while knowing when to build from established systems and guidelines.

• Present concepts and creative recommendations clearly, explain the thinking behind your work, and incorporate feedback with confidence and care.

• Manage multiple projects at different stages, balancing deadlines, quality, stakeholder needs, and available resources.

• Collaborate with external agencies, freelancers, production partners, and vendors when additional support is needed.

• Contribute to and improve Pantheon ’s design systems, templates, asset libraries, workflows, and creative operations.

• Help raise the quality and consistency of design across the organisation through constructive critique, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

• Stay curious about emerging design practices, tools, technologies, and responsible uses of AI in creative work.

How Success Is Measured
Your success will be evaluated through a balanced view of:

• The quality, originality, and effectiveness of the creative work you deliver.

• Consistent and thoughtful application of Pantheon ’s brand across channels, markets, and experiences.

• The ability to turn complex ideas, products, and business priorities into clear and compelling visual communication.

• Strong partnership with cross-functional stakeholders and the ability to build alignment around creative decisions.

• Reliable project ownership, prioritisation, communication, and delivery against agreed timelines.

• Identify whitespace opportunities in the Salesforce ecosystem where Flosum can create new categories or capture market share from competitors.

• Translate deep Salesforce platform knowledge (metadata architecture, deployment models, Agentforce, Data Cloud, multi-org environments) into product capabilities that enterprise customers will pay premium prices for.

• Stay ahead of Salesforce's own product direction (three releases per year) and position Flosum to capitalize on every platform shift.

AI & Innovation

• Lead the next wave of AI-powered DevOps capabilities built on Agentforce, including intelligent deployment agents, AI-driven code review, automated security scanning, and predictive release management.

• Define how Flosum 's extensibility platform enables customers to build custom AI-driven workflows within Salesforce's trust boundary.

• Pioneer agent-aware governance: preparing Salesforce governance frameworks for autonomous systems and AI agents.

Customer & Market Insight

• Engage directly with Fortune 500 customers and prospects to deeply understand their pain points around Salesforce development, security, compliance, and data management.

description:

Join our dynamic and results-driven sales team! Founded in 2022, Grandir Solutions is a high-growth digital marketing agency start-up dedicated to driving growth and delivering exceptional results for our clients nationwide. If you’re an ambitious self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced environment where initiative is rewarded and professional growth is prioritized, you’ll fit right in. We believe sales is a craft, and we train and develop our team to help them master it.

This role manages and handles the end of the Grandir sales cycle, from discovery, demo, to contract negotiation. At Grandir, we foster a fun and inclusive team-based culture and provide training, mentorship, and development to enable your success. As an AE, you will engage with prospective customers articulating the Grandir value proposition to close new business.

title: Associate Director, Merchandise Planning
description:
Associate Director, Merchandise Planning
Brilliant Earth is searching for an Associate Director, Merchandise Planning to lead our Inventory Planning function and the team behind it. Reporting to the Senior Director of Merchandising, you'll own forecasting, open-to-buy, and inventory strategy across every category and function, as well as the roadmap that takes our planning capabilities to the next level. This is a builder's role as much as a planner's: our planning infrastructure is actively evolving, and you'll set the direction, partner with Technology and Merchandising to implement new tools, and raise the analytical bar for the whole team.
You'll build planning approaches that work for attribute-based, specification-driven assortments while holding the line on turn, in-stock, and margin. We have a social and environmental mission at the core of our company, and we're looking for someone excited to deliver exceptional business results while helping us advance it.
What You'll Do:
Inventory Strategy and Forecasting

• Own sales and inventory forecasts across all categories and functions, and hold the team accountable for the accuracy, timeliness, and achievement of inventory plans and KPIs.

• Set inventory strategy for fine jewelry assortments, including diamond, gemstone, and precious metal commodities, establishing the parameters (weeks of supply, safety stock, reorder points) that balance service levels against inventory productivity.

• Lead inventory planning for new showroom launches and growth initiatives, directing the scenario modeling and statistical analysis that pressure-test those plans.

Open-to-Buy and Financial Planning

• Own and continue to evolve the OTB alignment and consensus process, translating financial plans into actionable buying strategies with Merchandising and Finance.

• Contribute to the annual bookings, ASP, and margin budget-setting process, bringing the inventory point of view to category and department targets and reporting consistently against inventory KPIs.

Planning Systems and Process

• Create and drive the Inventory Planning roadmap. Work with leadership to initiate, prioritize, and approve projects, and manage long-term program schedules through to adoption.

• Partner with Technology on planning system implementation and maintenance, leading the broader team’s adoption of new demand planning and reporting tools.

• Adapt planning tools and models to integrate cleanly with our evolving enterprise systems and reporting, identifying gaps, developing workarounds, and replacing them with durable solutions.

• Leverage AI tools to automate recurring analysis and reporting, and drive identification and rollout of new AI-enabled planning workflows across the function.

Team Leadership and Partnership

• Manage, coach, and develop a growing planning team through hiring, feedback, and clear team objectives.

• Raise planning fluency across the organization by mentoring cross-functional Merchandising partners on forecasting and inventory principles, and by representing Planning credibly to executive leadership.

What You Bring:

• 10+ years in merchandise planning, inventory planning, forecasting, or quantitative analysis within retail, product, or e-commerce, including demonstrated success leading and developing a team.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certification a plus.

• Experience with attribute-based or commodity inventory planning (precious metals, gemstones, or other specification-driven categories) is a strong plus.

• Expert Excel skills: complex formulas, pivot tables, financial modeling, and efficient handling of large datasets. Retail math is second nature.

• Hands-on experience with demand planning software (Blue Yonder, Logility, Demantra, o9, MI9, or similar) and reporting/BI tools (Domo, Tableau, Power BI); NetSuite or comparable ERP experience a plus.

About the team + role

Robinhood is seeking a Senior Manager, Valuation to lead and execute valuation analyses for private company investments, minority equity stakes, and other illiquid financial instruments held across the organization. This role will partner closely with Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting (TAFR), Corporate Development, and the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee to ensure valuations are well-supported, defensible, and compliant with US GAAP (ASC 820, ASC 321/323) and SEC reporting requirements. This role reports into Technical Accounting & Financial Reporting (TAFR) leadership and works closely with the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, and Chicago, IL office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

What you’ll do

Financial Modeling & Valuation Analysis

Governance & Reporting

• Prepare valuation memos and supporting documentation for presentation to the RHV Private Markets Valuation Committee and Audit Committee.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Advise on the accounting and valuation implications of new or complex investment structures (e.g., tiered/contingent consideration, equity-linked instruments).

Process & Controls

• Drive continuous improvement of valuation templates, market data inputs, and benchmarking practices.

What you bring

• 10+ years of relevant experience in valuation, financial modeling, investment banking, or private equity/venture capital, with a focus on private company or illiquid investment valuation.

• Demonstrated expertise in building and auditing complex financial models (DCF, comparable company analysis, option pricing models, waterfall/allocation models).

• Strong working knowledge of US GAAP fair value measurement guidance (ASC 820) and its application to private investments.

• Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting valuation conclusions to committees, auditors, or senior stakeholders.

SHE-CAN (an acronym for Supporting Her Education Changes A Nation) is a global non-profit organization located in San Francisco, California USA, that builds female global leadership in post-conflict countries - Rwanda, Cambodia, Liberia and Guatemala. We help passionate young leaders win scholarships to U.S. colleges and universities, provide leadership training, and pair them with U.S. mentor teams who help them thrive in college and launch change-agent careers at home. CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future.

By joining our rapidly growing Accounting Advisory practice you will serve as a trusted partner to our clients. You’ll bring your first-hand experience, unique perspectives, and functional knowledge to deliver tailored integrated solutions that solve today's challenges and set the foundation for future success. With support from experienced leaders and a dedicated coach, you will join a collaborative community that invites you to contribute beyond the scope of client delivery.
What You'll Do:

• Perform technical accounting research on complex accounting issues including debt / equity transactions, revenue recognition, stock-based compensation, consolidations, business acquisitions, divestitures, leases, statement of cash flows presentation, etc.

• Prepare technical accounting memorandums documenting research performed and conclusions reached

• Support the implementation of technical accounting matters, including preparing journal entries and drafting accounting policies and processes

• Communicate and support technical accounting analyses and conclusions with client stakeholders and external auditors

• Prepare external financial reporting, including the primary financial statements and footnote disclosures

• Keep informed of new and evolving accounting topics

• Communicate effectively with clients to convey project findings, updates and recommendations

• Collaborate with CrossCountry and client team members regarding business issues and potential solutions

• Assist with project administration (e.g., project setup and planning, budgeting, account management, billing)

• Contribute to developing and implementing firm-approved, AI-enabled solutions for clients, in accordance with company policies on data protection, intellectual property, and professional standards.

• Stay informed about emerging AI tools and techniques and collaborate with firm leadership to identify compliant opportunities to enhance client solutions and internal processes.

• Comfort with AI: Demonstrate ability to responsibly explore and adopt firm-approved AI tools to enhance productivity and innovation

• Continuous Learning Mindset: Openness to learning and applying emerging technologies including AI and automation in alignment with firm policies and client standards

What You'll Bring:

• 3+ years of relevant technical accounting and financial reporting experience

• Progressive experience in accounting advisory within public accounting (Big 4 or top-tier firms) and/or industry roles focusing on technical accounting

• In-depth knowledge of IFRS/U.S. GAAP accounting standards and financial reporting requirements

• Demonstrate ability and desire to research complex technical accounting issues and effectively communicate findings

• Professionalism and discretion when interacting with executives and clients

• Contribute to developing and implementing firm-approved, AI-enabled solutions for clients, in accordance with company policies on data protection, intellectual property, and professional standards

• Stay informed about emerging AI tools and techniques and collaborate with firm leadership to identify compliant opportunities to enhance client solutions and internal processes

title: Customer Success Operations Analyst
locationText: Boston, MA; Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA
description:
At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit klaviyo.com/careers  to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.

About the role

Our Customer Success Managers and Renewals Specialists do their best work when the plan, data, and rhythm behind them are solid. This role builds and runs all three. You'll own the numbers and mechanics that tell us who covers which customers, how much capacity we have, and how the book is performing, then turn them into reporting our leaders actually use.

You'll sit between CS leadership, Sales Ops, Finance, and Data. Some weeks you'll be modeling territory options before a quarter starts. Other weeks you'll be building the renewal ops view the team checks every morning. If you like work where the answer ships and people use it, you'll like this job.

What you'll do

Capacity, coverage, and assignments

• Maintain headcount and capacity models, and keep them current as hiring, attrition, and book growth change the picture.

• Support account assignment and territory planning for CS leadership: model options, run quarterly rebalancing, and carry out reassignments when someone leaves or a customer's needs change.

• Keep assignment data clean and consistent across Salesforce, Gainsight, and reporting, so what the field sees matches what leadership sees.

• Flag where coverage doesn't match customer value or risk, and recommend how to fix it.

Business reviews and performance reporting

• Build and run the data behind weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews (QBR/MBR), delivering inputs on time and with a clear point of view.

• Own renewal ops reporting: upcoming renewals, renewal status and activity, at-risk accounts, and retention outcomes. Forecast and pipeline are owned elsewhere; you'll use the same definitions.

• Create and maintain CS dashboards and reports that CSMs, managers and LT rely on to run their books.

• Help drive and maintain rhythm of business reporting across all CS and Renewals segments

Analysis and improvement

• Answer ad hoc questions from leaders with a recommendation, not a spreadsheet dump.

• Spot patterns in the data (churn drivers, coverage gaps, capacity strain) and bring them to the team before they're asked for.

• Automate recurring pulls and reports, and document the process so it doesn't live in one person's head.

• Work with Sales Ops, Finance, and Data teams to make sure definitions and numbers match across the company.

Who you are

• 3-5 years in Customer Success Ops, Sales/Revenue Ops, FP&A, or an analytics role supporting a go-to-market team, ideally at a SaaS company.

• Strong SQL and comfort in Tableau or a similar BI tool.

• Salesforce and Gainsight experience

• Advanced spreadsheet skills. You can build a capacity model that someone else can pick up and trust.

• Experience with territory design, account assignment, or capacity planning is a big plus.

• You explain data clearly to people who don't live in it, and you can tell a CSM, a director, and a VP what a number means for them.

• You're careful with details and still move fast. Reporting that's late or wrong doesn't help anyone.

• You're curious about why the number moved, not just what it is.

• You build tools and processes you'd want to inherit, not just ones that get you through this week.

Nice to have

• Experience supporting renewals or retention teams.

• Familiarity with health scoring or segmentation work.

• Python or Snowflake experience.

title: English to Latvian Medical Devices Linguist
description:
About Welo Life Sciences

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com

About the Role
We are looking for experienced English into Latvian linguists specializing in Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) documentation translation.
Key Responsibilities

• Translate medical device and in vitro diagnostics documentation from English (US) into Latvian.

• Perform Copy Edit (translation review) of translated content, ensuring accuracy, terminology consistency, and compliance with project-specific quality requirements.

• Review and address QA feedback and client feedback on flagged linguistic issues.

• Meet agreed deadlines and maintain high-quality standards across assigned tasks.

• Work within the client's CAT tool environment (memoQ 12.5 or higher), using the license provided by Welo Global .

• Follow project-specific instructions, workflows, and quality standards.

Field of Expertise

• Medical Devices: Instructions for Use (IFUs), User Manuals, product documentation, labeling, and other medical device-related materials.

• In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD): Diagnostic test documentation, Instructions for Use, product information, labeling, and other IVD-related materials.

Must-Have Criteria
Education and Professional Experience
Applicants must meet at least one of the following criteria:

• A degree in Translation, Linguistics, or Language Studies (or an equivalent degree); or

• A recognized graduate qualification in another field, plus a minimum of two years of full-time professional translation experience; or

• A minimum of five years of full-time professional translation experience.

Relevant Translation Experience

• At least two years of professional experience in Life Sciences translation, specifically in Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD).

• Proven experience translating medical documentation in the relevant fields.

• Experience limited to patent translation will not be considered sufficient.

• Ability to perform both Translation and Copy Edit tasks.

Technical Skills

• Mandatory: Experience with memoQ, version 12.5 or higher.

• A suitable desktop version of memoQ must be installed. A free version is acceptable; a license will be provided by Welo Global .

• Familiarity with Microsoft Word and document editing workflows.

Nice-to-Have

• Degree in Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, Biomedical Sciences, Clinical Research, Translation, Linguistics, Philology, or a related field.

• Previous in-house experience within a medical device manufacturer, diagnostics company, or Life Sciences organization.

• Experience with ISO standards and quality-controlled translation workflows.

Project Details

• Language Pair: English (US) into Latvian.

• Service Line: Life Sciences - Medical Devices.

• Task Types: Translation and Copy Edit.

• Expected Capacity: Ongoing weekly availability.

Translation is paid per word, while Copy Edit is compensated per hour or per word, depending on the task size. For smaller Copy Edit assignments, payment will be calculated per word, as minimum fees cannot be offered.

title: Server Test Engineer
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Lead the development, validation, and optimization of manufacturing test solutions for high-performance storage servers and flash storage drive architectures within Pure's fast-paced Hyperscale Business Unit. In this high-impact position, you will drive drive-level to system-level test coverage, efficiency, and product reliability from early NPI bring-up through high-volume production. You will work closely with Hardware Engineering, Test Engineering, Quality, and global manufacturing partners to deliver scalable, bulletproof server infrastructure and flash storage solutions.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Drive L6 & Sub-Server Level Test Coverage: Own end-to-end manufacturing test strategies, diagnostic sequences, and rack-level test infrastructure, with a deep focus on L6 drive-level validation (SSDs, NVMe, PCIe) below the standard server level.

• NPI & DVT Execution: Drive test readiness and execution for critical NPI builds, including upcoming November DVT milestones, ensuring seamless bring-up, comprehensive BOM verification, and early defect detection.

• Cross-Functional System Integration: Partner closely with Hardware, Firmware, Quality, and Operations Engineering to validate early hardware builds for new server SKUs , and Direct Flash Modules (DFMs).custom flash drives, and Direct Flash Modules (DFMs).

• Automation & Diagnostic Tooling: Build and maintain Python or Shell automation scripts, PXE boot environments, and drive diagnostic tools while integrating test logs into manufacturing analytics dashboards for real-time yield visibility.

• Manufacturing & Supply Chain Leadership: Provide hands-on technical leadership, manufacturing test design, and on-site support to global ODM/JDM and contract manufacturing partners during line bring-up, yield optimization, and test escape prevention.

• Quality & Yield Optimization: Collaborate with Quality and Reliability teams to analyze failure data, continuously refine test coverage, enforce strict BOM validation, and drive high First Pass Yield (FPY) across manufacturing lines.

• Manufacturing Data & Scale: Build scalable test infrastructure and data pipelines that convert growing volumes of manufacturing and field data into actionable insights for faster failure detection, predictive quality, yield optimization, and continuous improvement.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Passion for Excellence: Apply a relentless focus on quality, precision, and continuous improvement to ensure every system meets the highest standards and delivers a dependable customer experience.

• Solid State Drive (SSD) / Flash Expertise: Hands-on background with flash memory architectures, NVMe/PCIe drive protocols, SSD firmware integration, and drive-level (L6) failure analysis within enterprise or hyperscale environments.

• Manufacturing & NPI Testing Experience: Proven track record running manufacturing test development, BOM validation, and hardware bring-up through NPI/DVT phases in high-volume compute or storage manufacturing setups.

• Technical & Diagnostic Proficiency: Deep expertise in Linux operating systems, PXE boot frameworks, BMC/IPMI interfaces, low-level storage diagnostics, and scripting languages (Python, Bash).

• Cross-Functional & Vendor Leadership: Strong ability to interface with external ODMs, contract manufacturers, and cross-functional internal teams to debug line issues and enforce quality standards.

description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

STRATEGIC ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, FEDERAL SALES - DOW

As a Strategic Account Executive, Federal Sales at SpaceXSI, you'll own revenue growth across a named territory of Department of War and defense accounts. You'll partner with engineering leaders and development teams to bring AI-powered software development into mission-critical programs, helping the people who build the nation's defense systems ship faster and more securely. You'll be a foundational member of our federal sales team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own a named book of DoW and defense accounts, driving new logo acquisition and expansion revenue against an annual quota

- Build and progress self-sourced pipeline through outbound prospecting, account mapping, and partner and integrator relationships

- Lead multi-threaded sales cycles across Engineering, Security, Procurement, Legal, and program leadership, from trial and technical evaluation through security review and large-scale rollout

- Build ROI cases tied to developer productivity, AI adoption, mission outcomes, and secure software delivery

- Navigate federal procurement, contract vehicles, and compliance requirements in partnership with Field Engineering and our AI Deployment team

- Share actionable customer feedback on product, compliance, and deployment needs to influence the roadmap

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- 5+ years of quota-carrying enterprise or federal technology sales experience

- Experience selling to Department of War or defense customers

- Active TS/SCI security clearance

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Experience selling developer tools, technical SaaS, infrastructure, or cybersecurity products

- Track record of closing new logos and expanding strategic accounts through self-sourced pipeline

- Experience selling to technical and mission buyers, including engineering leaders, program managers, CISOs, and CIOs

- Familiarity with federal contract vehicles, procurement processes, and security frameworks such as FedRAMP and DoD IL levels

- Experience working with systems integrators and channel partners in the defense ecosystem

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $200,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $350,000 - $400,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

description:
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role
We’re looking for a detail-oriented and organized Remote Bookkeeper to support the finance team with day-to-day accounting and administrative tasks for a property management portfolio.
In this role, you’ll work primarily with AppFolio and QuickBooks Online to manage accounts payable and receivable, process payments, reconcile bank and trust accounts, maintain accurate financial records, and support month-end reporting.
You’ll handle a high volume of daily transactions and work closely with the Director of Finance, while communicating with vendors, tenants, property owners, and internal team members. The ideal candidate has bookkeeping experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage financial tasks independently in a remote environment.
What You’ll Own
Accounts Payable

• Review, code, and enter vendor invoices in AppFolio.

• Create in-house maintenance invoices and bill tenants for tenant-caused repairs.

• Follow up on past-due invoices and respond to vendor payment inquiries.

• Maintain accurate vendor records, including W-9s, insurance documents, and payment methods.

• Prepare 1099 forms.

Accounts Receivable & Tenant Ledgers

• Post and reconcile rent receipts, deposits, and chargebacks.

• Prepare move-out security deposit dispositions within required timelines.

• Track overdue tenant payments and follow established collection policies.

• Maintain accurate collections logs and tenant account records.

Bank & Trust Reconciliations

• Reconcile operating, rent trust, and security deposit trust accounts daily.

• Investigate and resolve outstanding items, non-sufficient funds (NSF) transactions, and unmatched payments.

• Ensure financial transactions are accurately recorded and reconciled.

Month-End & Administrative Support

• Generate month-end reports and gather supporting documentation for the Director of Finance.

• Process owner distributions once approved.

• Monitor the finance inbox and respond to or route inquiries from owners, tenants, and staff.

• Keep owner, tenant, and vendor contact and payment information up to date.

Company Bookkeeping - QuickBooks Online

• Record receipts and expenses for company entities.

• Review and accurately categorize financial transactions.

• Prepare weekly billable-hours reports.

• Support commission and payroll data preparation.

Required Experience & Skills

• At least 2 years of experience in bookkeeping or accounting support, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations.

• Proficiency in AppFolio and QuickBooks Online.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

• Strong data entry skills with excellent accuracy and attention to detail.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage a high volume of daily transactions.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with owners, tenants, vendors, and internal teams.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment and follow established procedures.

• High level of professionalism and commitment to confidentiality when handling financial information.

Nice to Have

• Associate's or bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Experience in property management accounting.

• Familiarity with tenant ledgers, owner distributions, and security deposit accounting.

• Experience maintaining vendor records and preparing 1099 forms.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

• You are highly organized and comfortable handling detailed, repetitive financial tasks.

• You can manage multiple accounting priorities while maintaining accuracy.

• You take ownership of daily responsibilities and follow established processes.

• You proactively investigate discrepancies and follow up on unresolved transactions.

• You communicate professionally and handle sensitive financial information with discretion.

• You are reliable,

title: Senior Technical Product Manager – AI Agents
description:
NVIDIA is the defining technology company of the AI era. We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to lead NeMo Relay, an open-source library that helps developers observe and control what happens inside agent runs, without replacing the frameworks, models, or tools they already use.

Our team builds open-source libraries and reference architectures for agentic AI, including NeMo Relay, NeMo Fabric, and NemoClaw. We go to market through the ecosystem: our software is composed to be embedded into agent frameworks, developer tools, observability platforms, and third-party solutions, helping customers build agents that are safer, more observable, and more efficient on NVIDIA ’s stack.

What you'll be doing:

• Take charge of the vision, strategy, and multi-release roadmap for NeMo Relay as a framework-neutral library partners can embed, addressing lifecycle events, middleware, plugins, policy, observability, and adaptive performance tuning.

• Drive adoption through integrations with agent frameworks, coding-agent harnesses, observability vendors, and ISVs, and build the examples that show developers how to use Relay in real systems.

• Partner with the teams behind NeMo Guardrails, NeMo Fabric, NeMo Compass and OpenShell to make Relay work seamlessly with their components.

• Turn open-source community and ecosystem feedback into prioritized product decisions.

• Work with engineering and program management to plan releases and keep roadmap communications accurate.

• Become a recognized voice in agent observability, safety, and optimization through talks, content, and community engagement.

What we need to see:

• Deep familiarity with the AI agent landscape: open-source frameworks, coding agents and harnesses, and commercial agent platforms.

• Proven understanding of agent execution, including LLM calls, tool calls, and multi-agent workflows.

• Understanding of what developers need to operate agents in production: tracing, evaluation, guardrails, and cost and performance tuning.

• Product management background on developer-facing libraries, SDKs, or infrastructure that other companies build on.

• Proven track record to lead product direction in ambiguous, fast paced areas and to influence engineering, ecosystem, and leadership partners without direct authority.

• BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years of combined work in software development, ML ops, and/or technical product management, including 5+ years shipping enterprise software or infrastructure.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• History of taking an open-source project from early releases to broad ecosystem adoption.

• Track record of ecosystem-led go-to-market, such as integrations, co-engineering, or embedding into third-party products.

• Hands-on familiarity with OpenTelemetry, OpenInference, or agent tracing and evaluation tools.

• Ability to make exceptional runtime concepts simple for both developers and executives.

title: Talent Partner (NYC)
description:
Build the team that builds Conveo. As our first US-based Talent Partner, you'll source and close top talent as we scale past 100 people.

Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We're scaling past 100 people and delivering our 2027 hiring plan. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We're investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

 

WHAT WE’RE BUILDING

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer and B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Canva use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

 

THE ROLE

As our first US-based Talent Partner, you will build the team that builds the company. You'll work alongside the rest of our Talent and People team and play a big part in how we scale. You'll primarily work on roles based in the US, with some support on hiring across the UK and Belgium, helping us scale past 100 people and deliver our 2027 hiring plan.

You'll close exceptional talent across engineering, product, go-to-market, and operations, while contributing to hiring strategy and talent decisions. You won't be limited to one area. You'll work with stakeholders and leadership across departments. If your experience leans towards one area, such as product and engineering, go-to-market, or operations, that's fine. We're growing fast, so priorities shift and you'll often make calls with imperfect information.

Own hiring outcomes end-to-end

- Own roles from kickoff to close, including sourcing and closing

- Develop strong hiring judgment

- Provide external talent intelligence, including candidate availability, competitor activity, compensation, and wider market trends

- Be the main point of contact and advocate for candidates

- Every candidate hears back from us quickly, whether it's a yes or a no.

- Pitch Conveo with real conviction, because you understand the product, the market and why people join.

Grow our employer brand

- Contribute to employer branding content that shows what it's like to work at Conveo

- Support events that put Conveo in front of top talent

Build scalable hiring and people systems

- Improve interview loops, scorecards, and decision-mak

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.
Iron Mountain is seeking a strategic Director, Pre-Construction to join our Facilities and Construction Project Management team. In this executive leadership role, you will shape the early-stage trajectory of our data center portfolio across EMEA and APAC, turning complex site opportunities into build-ready realities. Stepping into a trusted, forward-looking organization, you will guide specialized pre-construction pods through technical due diligence, utility roadmaps, and stage-gate approvals so every new facility breaks ground on a rock-solid foundation.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)
In this role, you will:

• Govern Regional Stage-Gate Strategy: Own the pre-construction intake operating model across EMEA and APAC, guiding candidate site feasibility, test fits, cost benchmarks, and utility roadmaps through Stage 0 and Stage 1 approvals before seamless handovers to Construction leads.

• Lead and Deploy Pre-Construction Pods: Manage, coach, and allocate P2 and P3 Pre-Construction Managers across multidisciplinary pods-aligning Design, Cost Management, Scheduling, and Utilities to match pipeline demand.

• Drive Technical Innovation and Methodology: Standardize due diligence playbooks and elevate early site underwriting by embedding Whole-Life Costing (WLC), total cost of ownership (TCO), and embodied carbon benchmarks into the Ascent toolkit.

• Mitigate Risk and Align Executive Stakeholders: Maintain the regional pre-construction Risk Register, oversee third-party technical due diligence (TDD) consultants, and partner with Procurement on long-lead Owner-Furnished Equipment (OFE) to protect Ready for Service (RFS) timelines.

• Represent Construction in External and Executive Forums: Lead monthly pipeline reviews for senior leadership and engage directly with utility authorities, municipalities, and hyperscale customer technical leads on early-stage site viability.

What You’ll Bring (Skills & Qualifications)
The ideal candidate will have:

• 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in data center pre-construction, site development, feasibility, or early-stage capital project execution, backed by a university degree in Construction Management, Civil/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical discipline.

• Strong knowledge of hyperscale data center site layouts, power and water utility roadmaps, MEP infrastructure, environmental due diligence, and investment underwriting metrics such as CapEx per MW, Yield on Cost, and IRR.

• Proven experience building scalable pre-construction operating models, site intake playbooks, WLC models, and matrixes project pod frameworks.

• Demonstrated ability to line-manage and mentor international technical teams while negotiating effectively with utility executives, local authorities, and internal executive peers.

• Flexibility to work remotely in the UK with 30-40% travel across candidate project sites, utility offices, and regional hubs.

What We Offer (Benefits)

• Full-time permanent contract working 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday.
